email.subject: Demo request — fleet tracking for Q4
email.body_text:
Hi,

I lead operations at Northwind Logistics. We're evaluating fleet tracking vendors this quarter and your platform came up twice in our shortlist. Could we get a 30-minute demo next week? Thursday or Friday both work.

Best,
Sarah
